scope: data expansion prioritization for Phoenix fixed-24m model
problem: all tested candidates fail fixed-24m baseline and ECE gates

promotion_gate.required: one candidate must beat baseline on Brier and log-loss at all four anchors with ECE <= 0.05
promotion_gate.reason: promotion blocked until one candidate passes all anchors

missing_data_candidates.data: settled 24-month Phoenix notes with payoff, KI, autocall, coupon memory and maturity outcome
missing_data_candidates.priority_question: does it improve realized loss calibration?

missing_data_candidates.data: timestamped observation-date underlying levels and barrier monitoring paths
missing_data_candidates.priority_question: does it reduce path/payoff label error?

missing_data_candidates.data: BCS Capital quote timestamp, basket, barrier, tenor, coupon and quote status
missing_data_candidates.priority_question: does model coupon fit observed dealer economics?

missing_data_candidates.data: timestamped IV, skew, tenor and strike per underlying
missing_data_candidates.priority_question: does it improve P(KI) versus realized baseline?

missing_data_candidates.data: timestamped pairwise and tail correlation windows
missing_data_candidates.priority_question: does it improve worst-of dependence modeling?

missing_data_candidates.data: structured reason codes for KI, autocall miss, coupon loss and early redemption
missing_data_candidates.priority_question: does it separate label regimes and reduce calibration drift?

committee_questions: rank the missing data by expected information gain and implementation cost
define minimum sample sizes and freshness/provenance contracts
define acceptance metrics for fixed-24m Brier, log-loss, ECE and BCS quote-fit
identify leakage or survivorship risks for each data source
